I like the fit of these joggers. The material isn't as light weight as other UA joggers I've had. Says 80% cotton 20% Polyester. Nice black color that hasn't worn out after a few washes. I have some black joggers that stat to fade after on wash. Pockets are nice size. Overall a great pair of joggers.

This is a stunning necklace, especially against a dainty bare neck or a black turtleneck. The chain is very thin and easily knots if one is not careful. It is also 18" long with the clasp. I love the heart / tiara design.

Unfortunately, this gets lost on my neck. Because it is so dainty, this necklace is more suitable for a young slender female. It is perfect as a gift for a girlfriend and comes in a highly presentable box.
